The '''Qel-Droma belt''' was believed to have been the property of a member of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Qel-Droma family]], although it had not been established to whom specifically. Members of this family included the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light sided]] [[Cay Qel-Droma]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sided]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]. This belt increased the wearer's connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], while conferring protection from its influence. It is believed that the belt may have come into the possession of the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] sometime toward the end of the [[Dark Wars]].
